title: Vertical cylinder
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, create a new face and draw a single loop within it. Inside this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0096, 0.0096] with a radius of 0.0096. Apply a scale factor of 0.0192 to the entire 2D sketch to adjust its size. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the scaled 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the vertical cylinder will be 0.01923076923076923 units in both length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane at the XY plane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
circle = wp.center(0.0096, 0.0096).circle(0.0096)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
cylinder = circle.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is the cylinder
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0096, 0.0096)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0096)  # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
